SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Littering in markets

3. Which statement about Climatic regions in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Climatic regions in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   B. Say Climatic regions in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Climatic regions in Eastern Africa.
   D. Explain Climatic regions in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Language groups in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

8. Which statement about Population distribution in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Population distribution in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Population distribution in Eastern Africa.
   C. Explain Population distribution in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Population distribution in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa.
   B. Explain Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   D. Say Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

   A. Treat Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa.

13. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Hide all money underground

14. Which statement about Historic Built Environments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments.

   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Name the president

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
